summary.zh: 生成并维护 OpenAPI 3.1 接口规范

description.zh: 从代码或设计稿产出 OpenAPI 3.1 规范，并检查接口描述是否前后一致、是否满足约定。适合补全 API 文档、为生成 SDK 做准备，以及在接口变更后校验契约。
description.en: Produces OpenAPI 3.1 specs from code or a design-first draft and checks the description for consistency. Useful for completing API docs, preparing SDK generation, or validating contracts after interface changes.
